verses.zh: 智慧岂不呼叫？聪明岂不发声？
verses.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.en: Listen — is wisdom not calling out? Is understanding not raising her voice?

verses.zh: 她在道旁高处的顶上，在十字路口站立，
verses.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.en: She stands on the high places beside the road, where the paths meet.

verses.zh: 在城门旁，在城门口，在城门洞，大声说：
verses.kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.en: Beside the gates, at the entrance to the city, at the doorways, she calls out loudly:

verses.zh: 众人哪，我呼叫你们，我向世人发声。
verses.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
verses.en: "I am calling to all of you, everybody; I am speaking to every person.

verses.zh: 说：愚蒙人哪，你们要会悟灵明；愚昧人哪，你们当心里明白。
verses.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.en: You who are simple, learn some sense; you who are foolish, understand in your heart.

verses.zh: 你们当听，因我要说极美的话；我张嘴要论正直的事。
verses.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.en: Listen, because I will say excellent things; what I open my mouth to say is right.

verses.zh: 我的口要发出真理；我的嘴憎恶邪恶。
verses.kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.en: My mouth speaks the truth, and my lips hate what is wrong.

verses.zh: 我口中的言语都是公义，并无弯曲乖僻。
verses.kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.en: Everything I say is fair; nothing in it is twisted or crooked.

verses.zh: 有聪明的，以为明显，得知识的，以为正直。
verses.kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.en: It is all clear to a person who understands, and right to anyone who has found knowledge.

verses.zh: 你们当受我的教训，不受白银；宁得知识，胜过黄金。
verses.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.en: Take my teaching instead of silver, and knowledge instead of the finest gold,

verses.zh: 因为智慧比珍珠更美；一切可喜爱的都不足与比较。
verses.kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.en: because wisdom is better than jewels, and nothing you could want compares with her.

verses.zh: 我—智慧以灵明为居所，又寻得知识和谋略。
verses.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.en: I, wisdom, live together with good sense, and I know how to plan well.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华在乎恨恶邪恶；那骄傲、狂妄，并恶道，以及乖谬的口，都为我所恨恶。
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.en: Respecting the LORD means hating what is evil. I hate pride, showing off, the wrong road, and a twisted mouth.

verses.zh: 我有谋略和真知识；我乃聪明，我有能力。
verses.kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
verses.en: Good advice and real wisdom are mine; I am understanding, and I have strength.

verses.zh: 帝王借我坐国位；君王借我定公平。
verses.kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.en: Kings rule because of me, and leaders make fair decisions.

verses.zh: 王子和首领，世上一切的审判官，都是借我掌权。
verses.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.en: Princes and nobles and every fair judge on earth govern through me.

verses.zh: 爱我的，我也爱他；恳切寻求我的，必寻得见。
verses.kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.en: I love those who love me, and whoever looks for me carefully will find me.

verses.zh: 丰富尊荣在我；恒久的财并公义也在我。
verses.kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.en: Riches and honour are with me, lasting wealth and doing what is right.

verses.zh: 我的果实胜过黄金，强如精金；我的出产超乎高银。
verses.kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.en: What I give is better than gold, even pure gold, and better than the finest silver.

verses.zh: 我在公义的道上走，在公平的路中行，
verses.kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.en: I walk along the road of doing right, on the paths of fairness,

verses.zh: 使爱我的，承受货财，并充满他们的府库。
verses.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.en: giving real riches to those who love me, and filling up their storerooms.

verses.zh: 在耶和华造化的起头，在太初创造万物之先，就有了我。
verses.kjv: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.en: The LORD had me at the very beginning, before he made anything else.

verses.zh: 从亘古，从太初，未有世界以前，我已被立。
verses.kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.en: I was set in place long, long ago, before the world began.

verses.zh: 没有深渊，没有大水的泉源，我已生出。
verses.kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.en: Before there were any deep seas, before there were any springs of water, I was born.

verses.zh: 大山未曾奠定，小山未有之先，我已生出。
verses.kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.en: Before the mountains were set in place, before the hills, I was born.

verses.zh: 耶和华还没有创造大地和田野，并世上的土质，我已生出。
verses.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.en: This was before he made the earth, or the fields, or the first speck of dust in the world.

verses.zh: 他立高天，我在那里；他在渊面的周围，划出圆圈。
verses.kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.en: When he put the sky in place, I was there; when he drew a circle around the deep sea,

verses.zh: 上使穹苍坚硬，下使渊源稳固，
verses.kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.en: when he set the clouds above and made the springs of the deep strong,

verses.zh: 为沧海定出界限，使水不越过他的命令，立定大地的根基。
verses.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.en: when he told the sea how far it could come and laid the foundations of the earth —

verses.zh: 那时，我在他那里为工师，日日为他所喜爱，常常在他面前踊跃，
verses.kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.en: I was beside him like a master builder. I was his delight day after day, always glad in front of him,

verses.zh: 踊跃在他为人预备可住之地，也喜悦住在世人之间。
verses.kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
verses.en: glad about the world he made, and happy to be with people.

verses.zh: 众子啊，现在要听从我，因为谨守我道的，便为有福。
verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.en: So now, children, listen to me: happy are those who keep to my ways.

verses.zh: 要听教训就得智慧，不可弃绝。
verses.kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.en: Listen to teaching and be wise; do not throw it away.

verses.zh: 听从我、日日在我门口仰望、在我门框旁边等候的，那人便为有福。
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.en: Happy is the person who listens to me, waiting at my door every day, watching beside my gate,

verses.zh: 因为寻得我的，就寻得生命，也必蒙耶和华的恩惠。
verses.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
verses.en: because whoever finds me finds life, and the LORD will be pleased with them.

verses.zh: 得罪我的，却害了自己的性命；恨恶我的，都喜爱死亡。
verses.kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.en: But whoever misses me hurts their own self; everyone who hates me loves death."
